verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a REST API, event-driven webhooks, and an MCP server, but nothing that lets a user define recurring scheduled jobs or workflows inside Fellow. Webhooks fire on events, not on a recurring schedule, and the API endpoints are one-off calls that a user would have to schedule with external tooling. That is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
